Smooth glassy water maintains a sharp, largely unchanged mirrored reflection of the tree and sky glow.

caption: The video captures a quiet, low-light landscape in which a single leafless tree stands as a dark silhouette at the center of a thin horizon ridge. Above the tree, the sky shifts from deep blue-black at the top to a pale glow directly behind its branches, while faint stars remain scattered across the upper field. Below the ridge, a flat water surface mirrors the tree and the soft sky light, holding the same centered composition throughout the scene. The tree itself does not translate, grow, or collapse; its outline and the mirrored reflection keep the same position across the visible span. The water stays smooth and glassy, so the reflected branches remain sharp and largely unchanged rather than shimmering. Small bright specks appear at varying spots on the lower half of the scene, emerging and fading as faint points without any clear drifting path. The camera framing stays effectively static, leaving the visible change to these flickering points rather than any larger scene motion.
